featured_reviews.name: priyak midder
featured_reviews.review_text:
Theobroma at Peddar Road has become my go-to indulgence spot! I’ve been here multiple times and every visit has been a treat. Their red velvet pastry is soft, rich, and just the right amount of sweet. The butter croissant is flaky perfection, and their assortment of chocolate pastries is a chocolate lover’s dream (good luck picking just one 😄). Paired it all with a warm cappuccino—no complaints at all.

The vibe is cozy, the service is quick, and the desserts never disappoint. If you're in the area, just walk in—you won’t regret it. ✨

featured_reviews.name: ninad joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Food is standard French patisserie fare - fairly good.
This review is for the atrociously poor service if I can even call it service. Absolutely pathetic - staff totally uninterested, completely aloof and do not even acknowledge the presence of the customer. They behave as if they are doing the customer a favor by serving them. They were on their phone or were fulfillng online orders. Not even a line saying they will help me in a moment. I left after 10 mins and will not be returning ever. Staff needs real training in good customer service.
Only visit this place if you like to be ignored.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for giving your time on call.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Hattiangadi
featured_reviews.review_text:
They don't open the store on time and then were not allowing me to buy a sandwich. Something to do with "counting the number of items first before starting the sale."

So then do it before you open the store. It's open at 8am I went in to get my sandwich around 8:45am. 45 minutes after the store was officially open! Poor management.

Incredibly dissappointed, I mean I understand company policy but I was hungry and was craving for a sandwich. Just lacked basic human decency man!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Amit,
We apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced and appreciate the opportunity to learn more about it. To further discuss your experience, please share your contact information via https://forms.gle/WyDVnCScucG8eVx1A Our team will be in touch with you shortly.
Thanks,
Team Theobroma

featured_reviews.name: Saaniya Padaria
featured_reviews.review_text:
The food is great, but the delivery service from the website itself honestly is terrible. I’ve tried getting deliveries from two different outlets, including Peddar Road - and this time my family members birthday cake came with broken chocolate pieces. This is after I called the central Theobroma in the morning to be assured of timely delivery, service and caution as this was a special occasion. The last time I had ordered a gift and they did not bother even telling me that they couldn’t deliver it within the time frame or give me a heads up or solution.

They should just stick to in person service.

featured_reviews.name: imran badami
featured_reviews.review_text:
Back to theobroma for my monthly escapades, this time it was the Pedder Road outlet.

The ambience theobromish. The service here was excellent.

I was here to try their cake clubs limited edition cashew and chocolate mousse pastry but was disappointed as the pastry didn't appeal to me the way it did in the pictures posted on social media.

Can't be at Theobroma and not eat anything so i had their world famous Millionaire brownie. Looks wavey but 10 seconds in the mircrowave and u are left with a pool of chocolate. I polished off the brownie in no time.

At theobroma the brownies will take away your frownies.

featured_reviews.name: Judheim Kassamali
featured_reviews.review_text:
When you expect HUGE things from cute lil places, you will likely end up disappointed. This cosy little patisserie was firstly surprisingly offering eggless and gluten free pastries. I wanted to push further and ask if they were lactose free too (but I wasnt trying to be a ..pain). The Dutch Truffle Deluxe was all it was described to be. Smooth creamy soft texture of dark chocolate ganache satisfied that chocolate crave (9/10).    The ferrero pastry though wasn't ferrero enough for me so 7/10.  The Americano was FANTASTIC. I loved the flavorful roasted bean flavour. The barista(-ess) was attentive and kind.

The little cafe, was a delight. Can't wait to try the cold craft beer and cold sandwich in the midday heat next!

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Dutt
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience!
I ordered a bouquet of chocolates from Birdy's after seeing it clearly listed on their Zomato page. I waited patiently for almost 50 minutes, only to receive a call later saying the product isn’t available. This is absolutely unacceptable.

If you don’t have a product, don’t mislead customers by showing it online. This shows poor management, lack of coordination, and zero respect for customers’ time. I was genuinely looking forward to trying Birdy's, but after this experience, I have no intention of ever ordering or visiting again.

Such a pathetic level of service completely ruins trust. Please fix your listings and your attitude toward customers.

Warden Bakery situated at August Kranti Maiden. Just next to Camy Wafer shop.
The name bakery itself is a self explanatory name where you can avail various biscuits, breads, pastries.
You can really enjoy the fresh baked breads, you name it and all sort of breads are available - Pizza, Dabeli, Garlic, Sweet, Regular breads to name a few.
Their pastries are exclusive, you will not find them at any other place.
The Almond tart, Butterscotch tart, Coconut biscuits, cream rolls, just fantastic, one cannot stop eating.
You can even purchase Mayoniese, Ketchups, different sauces required for preparing Pizzas and other tantalizing dishes.
Chocolate, Strawberry pastries - Oh My God!
Quick service and staff informs the customer to maintain safe distance.
It is open till 8.30 p.m.
Don't miss an opportunity to enjoy their mouth watering tarts, if one is present in the nearby area.

featured_reviews.name: Poushalee Dey
featured_reviews.review_text:
CRÈME Cookies – A Warm, Gooey Delight in Tardeo

CRÈME Cookies, a recent addition to Mumbai’s dessert scene, specializes in thick, chunky, New York-style cookies that promise a perfect balance of crisp edges and gooey centers. Tucked away in Tardeo, this spot has already built a reputation for serving some of the most indulgent cookies in the city.

From the moment we walked in, the aroma of freshly baked cookies filled the air, setting the perfect mood for a sugar rush. We ordered a mix of their bestsellers, including classic chocolate, Nutella-filled creations, and a couple of their signature cake cups. Each bite was rich, buttery, and decadent without being overly sweet. The cookies were served warm and fresh, with a satisfyingly soft, melt-in-the-mouth texture. The cake cups, too, were indulgent, though some flavors stood out more than others.

While the flavors were spot on, we felt that some cookies could have used a bit more contrast in texture, perhaps a slightly crispier exterior to balance out the gooey center. The cake cups, while tasty, could have packed a little more depth in certain flavors. That said, CRÈME definitely knows how to make a seriously good cookie.

With a premium price tag, it’s not an everyday indulgence, but for anyone who loves big, bold, and gooey cookies, CRÈME is absolutely worth a visit. A strong 4/5 from us—nearly perfect, and dangerously addictive.

Would we return? Without a doubt.
